verdict.rationale: Notte's documented approach centers on DOM-based 'observe()' calls, element IDs/selectors, and action-space scripting rather than a vision/screenshot-driven action mode; no evidence pack item describes a computer-use or screenshot-based fallback mode for canvases/UIs the DOM can't parse. A community comment even questions why an action-space approach (Notte's actual design) would be more reliable than screenshots+HTML, reinforcing that vision-mode is not part of the product's documented capability.
